hardware: 1 vCPU sandbox VM, ~4GB RAM -- see notes
notes: At 100K, the default HNSW build spawned parallel maintenance workers that contended for the single available core rather than speeding things up; rebuilding with max_parallel_maintenance_workers=0 (single-threaded) completed successfully. Brute-force numbers at 100K were measured by disabling index/bitmap scans on the already-HNSW-indexed table (forcing a real seq scan) rather than rebuilding the table without an index, to avoid a second multi-minute run -- the seq scan cost is identical either way.

results.indexBuildNote: default (parallel) build did not complete in over 9 minutes on this 1-vCPU sandbox; single-threaded rebuild (max_parallel_maintenance_workers=0) succeeded, exact duration not captured due to a background-process logging issue, but completed within roughly 90-180s based on polling
